summary: Temporary danger area EGD298D near Coventry, daily 0700 to 2300, up to 900 feet above sea level.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD298D INSTALLED WI AREA BOUNDED BY
522253N 0012920W THEN CLOCKWISE ARC OF A CIRCLE RADIUS 1.78NM
CENTRED 522429N 0013037W TO 522613N 0013115W - 522648N 0012659W
THEN CLOCKWISE ARC OF A CIRCLE RADIUS 1.63NM CENTRED 522512N
0012728W TO 522344N 0012622W - 522253N 0012920W (COVENTRY).
BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX 
HGT 400FT AGL. EMERG SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN 
ACCORDANCE WITH LOCAL DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC 
CAT VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA WITHOUT 
PRIOR APPROVAL OR DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD FLIGHT, FLIGHT 
RESTRICTION ZONE OR CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE OBTAINED. 
OPERATORS ARE REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER CAP722 5.2.2.3 
REGARDING OPR IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE EFFORT. FOR
